name: smwmusic-synecdoche-new-york-dmi-we-meet-again
title: Synecdoche, New York - dmi we meet again?
description:
My first completed port.
Composed by Jon Brion, this song is from the film Synecdoche New York, directed by Charlie Kaufman. A depressing song for a depressing movie, perfect for title screens, credits, and cutscenes.

Ported by ear, samples used are from earthbound and musicalman's samples of insanity
